Prevention: Remove and burn crop residues and alternate host such as
Crop establishment: age of seedling (30-35 days); increase crop density; plant spacing to 45 cm
Establishment of border/ trap crops before 15 days of field planting and continue it.
Maize & finger millet as border crops; Sun hemp and sun flower as trap crops – these should be removed and destroyed after first flowering.
Palmyrah or coconut leaves; Insect proof net – before field planting construct 02m height net barrier around the field
Use recommended dose of nitrogenous fertilizers
Monitoring: Counting thrips in morning on upper surface of tender leaves on a weekly basis; Action should be taken when the first symptoms are seen
Direct Control: Extract (Boil 01kg leaves with 05 lit of water and dilute it 1:5 and spray)
Extract (soak 50g grinded seeds with 01 lit of water for 24 hrs, filter, dilute it 1:5, mix some soap and spray)
Neem oil+ soap solution (5ml of neem oil with 01 lit of water)
Restrictions: Max. no. of seed treatment: 1; Do not mix with other chemicals; WHO class
Max. no. of seed treatment: 1/ seed batch; Do not use with herbicides
